The climate in Ohrid

Ohrid is about 700 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 28°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 0°C. Around 820 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 112 mm).

Best time to visit Ohrid

The most pleasant weather in Ohrid is usually in June and September: average highs are between 23°C and 25°C, with up to 10 days of rain a month.
